heading: Repealed. Pub. L. 119–60, div. C, title XXXI, § 3111(b)(1), Dec. 18, 2025, 139 Stat. 1458

notes.text: Section, Pub. L. 107–314, div. D, title XLIII, § 4306B, formerly Pub. L. 108–375, div. C, title XXXI, § 3132, Oct. 28, 2004, 118 Stat. 2166; Pub. L. 109–364, div. C, title XXXI, § 3113, Oct. 17, 2006, 120 Stat. 2504; Pub. L. 112–239, div. C, title XXXI, § 3118, Jan. 2, 2013, 126 Stat. 2173; Pub. L. 115–232, div. notes.heading: Acceleration of Replacement of Cesium Blood Irradiation Sources
notes.text: Pub. L. 115–232, div. C, title XXXI, § 3141, Aug. 13, 2018, 132 Stat. 2303, which related to programs designed to eliminate the use of blood irradiation devices in the United States that rely on cesium chloride by Dec. 31, 2027, was repealed by Pub. L. 119–60, div. C, title XXXI, § 3111(b)(15), Dec. 18, 2025, 139 Stat. 1459. See section 6156 of Title 10, Armed Forces.
